authority: #K2-444 sec.2.3/2.4: (i) read the R-g bridge effect separately, (ii) implement the zone-aware C6 row. Zero exam runs.

R_g_read_on_the_R1332_judged_board.DECISIVE_FINDING: the bridge zone I added is NOT on the final board (the zone list still holds only the two originals) => the chain's own isolated-copper disposal stage removed it: after refill its fill touches no pad, so it is an orphan island and is disposed. R-g mechanism B therefore CANNOT work as drawn under the chain's current order.
R_g_read_on_the_R1332_judged_board.implication: R-g must be re-thought as either (a) a bridge that is anchored to the P3V3 pads/routes (so it is not an orphan), or (b) a zone-outline/priority change on the EXISTING finger zone (which IS anchored), or (c) a declared change that the disposal stage is told to keep.

C6_zone_aware_implemented.what: the C6 row now compares zone-aware outside_geometry(include_zones=True) and additionally reports legacy_diff
C6_zone_aware_implemented.why: #K2-444 sec.2.4 ordered the row to use the zone-aware read; the previous attempt failed on an ambiguous literal (4 call sites) - this edit targets the single call inside wipe_resolve_chain.
C6_zone_aware_implemented.measured_expectation: per R1322, a judged board's zone-aware C6 diff is ~943 vs the baseline, so this row is expected to FAIL until either the chain stops touching outside fills or the supervisor restates the scope.
